association_policy: fixed iteration-10 hard associations inherited through the sealed parent
timing_policy: fixed group timing inherited from iteration 10
model: exact SGP4 causal per-NORAD rate with profiled per-track CFO
objective: equal-group mean of regularized exact cap-800 selection objectives
transition_rule: translate at unchanged spacing while the winner is on the 3x3 edge; advance to the next stage only after an interior winner
termination_rule: stop after the final stage, or stop unqualified if any stage exhausts its translation budget on an edge
reuse_policy: cache and reuse exact group-coordinate fits shared by overlapping lattices
postseal_policy: the geographic reference may be read only after inference.json is sealed
